item.text:
It is **not** a temporary hand-written stub anymore; the project moved to the generated production ontology in `ontologies/software-architecture.ttl` (with `ontologies/software-architecture_shapes.ttl`) from Trivyn Ontology Pipeline v0.8.0.  
The previous stub was retired, and the ontology namespace is now `https://trivyn.io/ontologies/software/architecture/domain/` (not `moosedev.dev`).
